strings.guide.text:
Quest 3:
  3x L3 (Left): Toggle this VR HUD
  3x R3 (Right): Toggle Flight <-> Edit VR Origin
  X Button (Left): Toggle VR Raycaster Mouse in IL-2 Menus
  Hold R/L GRIP: 6DoF Stick / Latched Throttle
  HUD Bottom Bar: Hold Trigger/Grip to reposition panel
  Y Button (Left): Recenter Origin at head pose
